purpose: A capacitor island behind a 0 V source or a small series resistor starts at its charge-division voltage, not 0 V.

oracle.derivation: At DC the island has no path to ground; the transient operating point settles it as the source steps on: equal series capacitors split 1 V, so v(i1) = v(i2) = 0.5 V for all t (no resistive discharge path). ngspice 45: 0.5 and 0.4999959 at t = 0. The 1 mOhm island settles to within 2e-4 V of 0.5 V at t = 0 (OPtran), hence atol 5e-4.
